correctness.rationale: PASS: The defining star class-three brackets yield a Kirillov block matrix with zero central rows and off-diagonal augmented m x (m+1) block T=[-alpha | B], B symmetric zero diagonal (alternating in characteristic two). Rank Kirillov=2 rank T; free functional coordinates on c and x_i contribute q^(m+1). The standard exact finite-field count of rank-2k alternating matrices is H_m,k=[m choose 2k]_q q^(k(k-1)) product_{j=1}^k(q^(2j-1)-1), obtained by radical selection and GL(2k,q)/Sp(2k,q). For such B precisely q^(2k) alpha vectors lie in its image, giving rank 4k; the other q^m-q^(2k) give rank 4k+2. Sum yields entire displayed P_mq and sum at t=1 equals q^dimL. Full maximal 2m rank is attainable for both parities of m, hence index 1+binom(m,2). Independent exact F2 counts m=2:(0:8,2:24,4:32), m=3:(0:16,2:112,4:448,6:448), and bounded larger m matched. General finite-field proof is analytical, not extrapolated.
